0.original: Managingway wants to spread the joy of music.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Ride the moon-hopper to the Carrotorium and perform the hop-step at the designated locations.

48.original: Ever since we built the musicking station, many Ways have developed a liking for music.

49.original: Many more, however, remain unaware of the station's pleasures, and I would like you to help spread the word.

50.original: If you're willing, please report to Ridingway yonder. He has charge of the advertising effort, and will provide you with instructions.

51.original: Ah, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Here to help us advertise the musicking station, yes?

52.original: There isn't anything to it, really. You just need to play a spot of music for some Ways out there.

53.original: Without further ado, ride this moon-hopper over to the Carrotorium. Once there, use its hop-step function near a crowd. The feel-good sound it produces is bound to put a spring in our fellows' steps!

55.original: Ride the moon-hopper over to the Carrotorium, and use its hop-step function near a crowd. The feel-good sound it produces is bound to put a spring in our fellows' steps!

56.original: Some Loporrits have gathered here. Speak with Ridingway in Hoper's Hold to mount the moon-hopper, then perform the hop-step in their midst.

57.original: (-Playful Loporrit-)Ooh, what agreeable, uplifting music! I can't help but want to rollick!

58.original: (-Playful Loporrit-)We can enjoy such feel-good sounds any time at this musicking station, you say? Thank you, we'll head there at once!

59.original: (-Playful Loporrit-)Oho, if it isn't the feel-good sounds of the musicking station! Such a wonderful place that was!

60.original: (-Playful Loporrit-)It's been too long since my last visit. I'll quickly finish up my work, then head over there again and hop till I drop!

62.original: (-Languid Loporrit-)M-My tail and ears, they move as if they possessed a mind of their own... What in creation was that joyful sound?

63.original: (-Languid Loporrit-)The musicking station... I never knew such a marvelous place existed. I'll pay a visit as soon as I can.

64.original: (-Languid Loporrit-)Oh, there it is again, the sound that makes my tail and ears want to dance...

65.original: (-Languid Loporrit-)I must say, I was quite impressed with the musicking station, with its animated atmosphere. I must pay another visit after work.

66.original: There you are, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. My colleagues at the musicking station are pleased to report a measurable increase in guests.

67.original: This is no doubt due to your efforts. We hope to advertise the facility on a regular basis, and when next we do so, I trust we can depend on you again.
